system_examples: Prometheus-compatible alerting services — evaluating metric cooldowns and sustained-threshold durations across streaming telemetry to manage alert escalation delays.
Financial backtesting platforms like QuantConnect — computing time-to-breakout metrics across historical price series to evaluate how long an asset takes to reach a higher price.
parsed.explanation: The problem is solved using a monotonic stack to maintain unresolved previous readings until a higher value arrives, reducing worst-case time complexity from O(N²) to O(N). Each element is pushed and popped at most once, which makes single-pass evaluation possible. In production systems handling large historical batches or continuous telemetry, this linear efficiency prevents processing backlogs and CPU spikes during high-throughput ingestion.
